spawn_review_thread(\n    sess: Arc&lt;Session&gt;,\n    config: Arc&lt;Config&gt;,\n    parent_turn_context: Arc&lt;TurnContext&gt;,\n    sub_id: String,\n    review_request: ReviewRequest,\n) {\n    let model = config.review_model.clone();\n    let review_model_family = find_family_for_model(&amp;model)\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| parent_turn_context.client.get_model_family());\n    // For reviews, disable web_search and view_image regardless of global settings.\n    let mut review_features = config.features.clone();\n    review_features\n        .disable(crate::features::Feature::WebSearchRequest)\n        .disable(crate::features::Feature::ViewImageTool);\n    let tools_config = ToolsConfig::new(&amp;ToolsConfigParams {\n        model_family: &amp;review_model_family,\n        features: &amp;review_features,\n    });\n\n    let base_instructions = REVIEW_PROMPT.to_string();\n    let review_prompt = review_request.prompt.clone();\n    let provider = parent_turn_context.client.get_provider();\n    let auth_manager = parent_turn_context.client.get_auth_manager();\n    let model_family = review_model_family.clone();\n\n    // Build per‑turn client with the requested model/family.\n    let mut per_turn_config = (*config).clone();\n    per_turn_config.model = model.clone();\n    per_turn_config.model_family = model_family.clone();\n    per_turn_config.model_reasoning_effort = Some(ReasoningEffortConfig::Low);\n    per_turn_config.model_reasoning_summary = ReasoningSummaryConfig::Detailed;\n    per_turn_config.features = review_features.clone();\n    if let Some(model_info) = get_model_info(&amp;model_family) {\n        per_turn_config.model_context_window = Some(model_info.context_window);\n    }\n\n    let otel_event_manager = parent_turn_context\n        .client\n        .get_otel_event_manager()\n        .with_model(\n            per_turn_config.model.as_str(),\n            per_turn_config.model_family.slug.as_str(),\n        );\n\n    let per_turn_config = Arc::new(per_turn_config);\n    let client = ModelClient::new(\n        per_turn_config.clone(),\n        auth_manager,\n        otel_event_manager,\n        provider,\n        per_turn_config.model_reasoning_effort,\n        per_turn_config.model_reasoning_summary,\n        sess.conversation_id,\n        parent_turn_context.client.get_session_source(),\n    );\n\n    let review_turn_context = TurnContext {\n        sub_id: sub_id.to_string(),\n        client,\n        tools_config,\n        developer_instructions: None,\n        user_instructions: None,\n        base_instructions: Some(base_instructions.clone()),\n        compact_prompt: parent_turn_context.compact_prompt.clone(),\n        approval_policy: parent_turn_context.approval_policy,\n        sandbox_policy: parent_turn_context.sandbox_policy.clone(),\n        shell_environment_policy: parent_turn_context.shell_environment_policy.clone(),\n        cwd: parent_turn_context.cwd.clone(),\n        final_output_json_schema: None,\n        codex_linux_sandbox_exe: parent_turn_context.codex_linux_sandbox_exe.clone(),\n        tool_call_gate: Arc::new(ReadinessFlag::new()),\n    };\n\n    // Seed the child task with the review prompt as the initial user message.\n    let input: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt; = vec![UserInput::Text {\n        text: review_prompt,\n    }];\n    let tc = Arc::new(review_turn_context);\n    sess.spawn_task(tc.clone(), input, ReviewTask).await;\n\n    // Announce entering review mode so UIs can switch modes.\n    sess.send_event(&amp;tc, EventMsg::EnteredReviewMode(review_request))\n        .await;\n}\n\nfn skill_load_outcome_for_client(\n    outcome: Option&lt;&amp;SkillLoadOutcome&gt;,\n) -&gt; Option&lt;SkillLoadOutcomeInfo&gt; {\n    outcome.map(|outcome| SkillLoadOutcomeInfo {\n        skills: outcome\n            .skills\n            .iter()\n            .map(|skill| SkillInfo {\n                name: skill.name.clone(),\n                description: skill.description.clone(),\n                path: skill.path.clone(),\n            })\n            .collect(),\n        errors: outcome\n            .errors\n Takes a user message as input and runs a loop where, at each turn, the model\n/// replies with either:\n///\n/// - requested function calls\n/// - an assistant message\n///\n/// While it is possible for the model to return multiple of these items in a\n/// single turn, in practice, we generally one item per turn:\n///\n/// - If the model requests a function call, we execute it and send the output\n///   back to the model in the next turn.\n/// - If the model sends only an assistant message, we record it in the\n///   conversation history and consider the task complete.\n///\npub(crate) async fn run_task(\n    sess: Arc&lt;Session&gt;,\n    turn_context: Arc&lt;TurnContext&gt;,\n    input: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt;,\n    cancellation_token: CancellationToken,\n) -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n    if input.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    let event = EventMsg::TaskStarted(TaskStartedEvent {\n        model_context_window: turn_context.client.get_model_context_window(),\n    });\n    sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, event).await;\n\n    let SkillInjections {\n        items: skill_items,\n        warnings: skill_warnings,\n    } = build_skill_injections(&amp;input, sess.services.skills.as_ref()).await;\n\n    for message in skill_warnings {\n        sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, EventMsg::Warning(WarningEvent { message }))\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    let initial_input_for_turn: ResponseInputItem = ResponseInputItem::from(input);\n    sess.record_input_and_rollout_usermsg(turn_context.as_ref(), &amp;initial_input_for_turn)\n        .await;\n\n    if !skill_items.is_empty() {\n        sess.record_conversation_items(&amp;turn_context, &amp;skill_items)\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    sess.maybe_start_ghost_snapshot(Arc::clone(&amp;turn_context), cancellation_token.child_token())\n        .await;\n    let mut last_agent_message: Option&lt;String&gt; = None;\n    // Although from the perspective of codex.rs, TurnDiffTracker has the lifecycle of a Task which contains\n    // many turns, from the perspective of the user, it is a single turn.\n    let turn_diff_tracker = Arc::new(tokio::sync::Mutex::new(TurnDiffTracker::new()));\n    let mut auto_compact_recently_attempted = false;\n\n    loop {\n        // Note that pending_input would be something like a message the user\n        // submitted through the UI while the model was running. Though the UI\n        // may support this, the model might not.\n        let pending_input = sess\n            .get_pending_input()\n            .await\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(ResponseItem::from)\n            .collect::&lt;Vec&lt;ResponseItem&gt;&gt;();\n\n        // Construct the input that we will send to the model.\n        let turn_input: Vec&lt;ResponseItem&gt; = {\n            sess.record_conversation_items(&amp;turn_context, &amp;pending_input)\n                .await;\n            sess.clone_history().await.get_history_for_prompt()\n        };\n\n        let turn_input_messages = turn_input\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|item| match parse_turn_item(item) {\n                Some(TurnItem::UserMessage(user_message)) =&gt; Some(user_message),\n                _ =&gt; None,\n            })\n            .map(|user_message| user_message.message())\n            .collect::&lt;Vec&lt;String&gt;&gt;();\n        match run_turn(\n            Arc::clone(&amp;sess),\n            Arc::clone(&amp;turn_context),\n            Arc::clone(&amp;turn_diff_tracker),\n            turn_input,\n            cancellation_token.child_token(),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(turn_output) =&gt; {\n                let TurnRunResult {\n                    processed_items,\n                    total_token_usage,\n                } = turn_output;\n                let limit = turn_context\n                    .client\n                    .get_model_family()\n                    .auto_compact_token_limit()\n                    .unwrap_or(i64::MAX);\n                let total_usage_tokens = total_token_usage\n                    .as_ref()\n                    .map(TokenUsage::tokens_in_context_window);\n                let token_limit_reached = total_usage_tokens\n                    .map(|tokens| tokens &gt;= limit)\n                    .unwrap_or(false);\n                let (responses, items_to_record_in_conversation_history) =\n                    process_items(processed_items, &amp;sess, &amp;turn_context).await;\n\n                if token_limit_reached {\n                    if auto_compact_recently_attempted {\n                        let limit_str = limit.to_string();\n                        let current_tokens = total_usage_tokens\n                            .map(|tokens| tokens.to_string())\n                            .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string());\n                        let event = EventMsg::Error(ErrorEvent {\n                            message: format!(\n                                \"Conversation is still above the token limit after automatic summarization (limit {limit_str}, current {current_tokens}). Please start a new session or trim your input.\"\n                            ),\n                        });\n                        sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, event).await;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                    auto_compact_recently_attempted = true;\n                    compact::run_inline_auto_compact_task(sess.clone(), turn_context.clone()).await;\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                auto_compact_recently_attempted = false;\n\n                if responses.is_empty() {\n                    last_agent_message = get_last_assistant_message_from_turn(\n                        &amp;items_to_record_in_conversation_history,\n                    );\n                    sess.notifier()\n                        .notify(&amp;UserNotification::AgentTurnComplete {\n                            thread_id: sess.conversation_id.to_string(),\n                            turn_id: turn_context.sub_id.clone(),\n                            cwd: turn_context.cwd.display().to_string(),\n                            input_messages: turn_input_messages,\n                            last_assistant_message: last_agent_message.clone(),\n                        });\n                    break;\n                }\n                continue;\n            }\n            Err(CodexErr::TurnAborted {\n                dangling_artifacts: processed_items,\n            }) =&gt; {\n                let _ = process_items(processed_items, &amp;sess, &amp;turn_context).await;\n                // Aborted turn is reported via a different event.\n                break;\n            }\n            Err(e) =&gt; {\n                info!(\"Turn error: {e:#}\");\n                let event = EventMsg::Error(ErrorEvent {\n                    message: e.to_string(),\n                });\n                sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, event).await;\n                // let the user continue the conversation\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    last_agent_message\n}\n\nasync fn run_turn(\n    sess: Arc&lt;Session&gt;,\n    turn_context: Arc&lt;TurnContext&gt;,\n    turn_diff_tracker: SharedTurnDiffTracker,\n    input: Vec&lt;ResponseItem&gt;,\n    cancellation_token: CancellationToken,\n) -&gt; CodexResult&lt;TurnRunResult&gt; {\n    let mcp_tools = sess.services.mcp_connection_manager.list_all_tools();\n    let router = Arc::new(ToolRouter::from_config(\n        &amp;turn_context.tools_config,\n        Some(mcp_tools),\n    ));\n\n    let model_supports_parallel = turn_context\n        .client\n        .get_model_family()\n        .supports_parallel_tool_calls;\n    let parallel_tool_calls = model_supports_parallel\n        &amp;&amp; turn_context\n            .client\n            .config()\n            .features\n            .enabled(Feature::ParallelToolCalls);\n    let prompt = Prompt {\n        input,\n        tools: router.specs(),\n        parallel_tool_calls,\n        base_instructions_override: turn_context.base_instructions.clone(),\n        output_schema: turn_context.final_output_json_schema.clone(),\n    };\n\n    let mut retries = 0;\n    loop {\n        match try_run_turn(\n            Arc::clone(&amp;router),\n            Arc::clone(&amp;sess),\n            Arc::clone(&amp;turn_context),\n            Arc::clone(&amp;turn_diff_tracker),\n            &amp;prompt,\n            cancellation_token.child_token(),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(output) =&gt; return Ok(output),\n            Err(CodexErr::TurnAborted {\n                dangling_artifacts: processed_items,\n            }) =&gt; {\n                return Err(CodexErr::TurnAborted {\n                    dangling_artifacts: processed_items,\n                });\n            }\n            Err(CodexErr::Interrupted) =&gt; return Err(CodexErr::Interrupted),\n            Err(CodexErr::EnvVar(var)) =&gt; return Err(CodexErr::EnvVar(var)),\n            Err(e @ CodexErr::Fatal(_)) =&gt; return Err(e),\n            Err(e @ CodexErr::ContextWindowExceeded) =&gt; {\n                sess.set_total_tokens_full(&amp;turn_context).await;\n                return Err(e);\n            }\n            Err(CodexErr::UsageLimitReached(e)) =&gt; {\n                let rate_limits = e.rate_limits.clone();\n                if let Some(rate_limits) = rate_limits {\n                    sess.update_rate_limits(&amp;turn_context, rate_limits).await;\n                }\n                return Err(CodexErr::UsageLimitReached(e));\n            }\n            Err(CodexErr::UsageNotIncluded) =&gt; return Err(CodexErr::UsageNotIncluded),\n            Err(e @ CodexErr::QuotaExceeded) =&gt; return Err(e),\n            Err(e @ CodexErr::RefreshTokenFailed(_)) =&gt; return Err(e),\n            Err(e) =&gt; {\n                // Use the configured provider-specific stream retry budget.\n                let max_retries = turn_context.client.get_provider().stream_max_retries();\n                if retries &lt; max_retries {\n                    retries += 1;\n                    let delay = match e {\n                        CodexErr::Stream(_, Some(delay)) =&gt; delay,\n                        _ =&gt; backoff(retries),\n                    };\n                    warn!(\n                        \"stream disconnected - retrying turn ({retries}/{max_retries} in {delay:?})...\",\n                    );\n\n                    // Surface retry information to any UI/front‑end so the\n                    // user understands what is happening instead of staring\n                    // at a seemingly frozen screen.\n                    sess.notify_stream_error(\n                        &amp;turn_context,\n                        format!(\"Reconnecting... {retries}/{max_retries}\"),\n                    )\n                    .await;\n\n                    tokio::time::sleep(delay).await;\n                } else {\n                    return Err(e);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// When the model is prompted, it returns a stream of events. Some of these\n/// events map to a &#96;ResponseItem&#96;. A &#96;ResponseItem&#96; may need to be\n/// \"handled\" such that it produces a &#96;ResponseInputItem&#96; that needs to be\n/// sent back to the model on the next turn.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct ProcessedResponseItem {\n    pub item: ResponseItem,\n    pub response: Option&lt;ResponseInputItem&gt;,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct TurnRunResult {\n    processed_items: Vec&lt;ProcessedResponseItem&gt;,\n    total_token_usage: Option&lt;TokenUsage&gt;,\n}\n\n#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]\nasync fn try_run_turn(\n    router: Arc&lt;ToolRouter&gt;,\n    sess: Arc&lt;Session&gt;,\n    turn_context: Arc&lt;TurnContext&gt;,\n    turn_diff_tracker: SharedTurnDiffTracker,\n    prompt: &amp;Prompt,\n    cancellation_token: CancellationToken,\n) -&gt; CodexResult&lt;TurnRunResult&gt; {\n    let rollout_item = RolloutItem::TurnContext(TurnContextItem {\n        cwd: turn_context.cwd.clone(),\n        approval_policy: turn_context.approval_policy,\n        sandbox_policy: turn_context.sandbox_policy.clone(),\n        model: turn_context.client.get_model(),\n        effort: turn_context.client.get_reasoning_effort(),\n        summary: turn_context.client.get_reasoning_summary(),\n    });\n\n    sess.persist_rollout_items(&amp;[rollout_item]).await;\n    let mut stream = turn_context\n        .client\n        .clone()\n        .stream(prompt)\n        .or_cancel(&amp;cancellation_token)\n        .await??;\n\n    let tool_runtime = ToolCallRuntime::new(\n        Arc::clone(&amp;router),\n        Arc::clone(&amp;sess),\n        Arc::clone(&amp;turn_context),\n        Arc::clone(&amp;turn_diff_tracker),\n    );\n    let mut output: FuturesOrdered&lt;BoxFuture&lt;CodexResult&lt;ProcessedResponseItem&gt;&gt;&gt; =\n        FuturesOrdered::new();\n\n    let mut active_item: Option&lt;TurnItem&gt; = None;\n\n    loop {\n        // Poll the next item from the model stream. We must inspect *both* Ok and Err\n        // cases so that transient stream failures (e.g., dropped SSE connection before\n        // &#96;response.completed&#96;) bubble up and trigger the caller's retry logic.\n        let event = match stream.next().or_cancel(&amp;cancellation_token).await {\n            Ok(event) =&gt; event,\n            Err(cancel_err) =&gt; {\n                let processed_items = output.try_collect().await?;\n                // zapabob: CancelErrがstructに変更されたため、dangling_artifactsを取得\n                let _dangling = cancel_err.dangling_artifacts.unwrap_or_default();\n                return Err(CodexErr::TurnAborted {\n                    dangling_artifacts: processed_items,\n                });\n            }\n        };\n\n        let event = match event {\n            Some(res) =&gt; res?,\n            None =&gt; {\n                return Err(CodexErr::Stream(\n                    \"stream closed before response.completed\".into(),\n                    None,\n                ));\n            }\n        };\n\n        let add_completed = &amp;mut |response_item: ProcessedResponseItem| {\n            output.push_back(future::ready(Ok(response_item)).boxed());\n        };\n\n        match event {\n            ResponseEvent::Created =&gt; {}\n            ResponseEvent::OutputItemDone(item) =&gt; {\n                let previously_active_item = active_item.take();\n                match ToolRouter::build_tool_call(sess.as_ref(), item.clone()) {\n                    Ok(Some(call)) =&gt; {\n                        let payload_preview = call.payload.log_payload().into_owned();\n                        tracing::info!(\"ToolCall: {} {}\", call.tool_name, payload_preview);\n\n                        let response =\n                            tool_runtime.handle_tool_call(call, cancellation_token.child_token());\n\n                        output.push_back(\n                            async move {\n                                Ok(ProcessedResponseItem {\n                                    item,\n                                    response: Some(response.await?),\n                                })\n                            }\n                            .boxed(),\n                        );\n                    }\n                    Ok(None) =&gt; {\n                        if let Some(turn_item) = handle_non_tool_response_item(&amp;item).await {\n                            if previously_active_item.is_none() {\n                                sess.emit_turn_item_started(&amp;turn_context, &amp;turn_item).await;\n                            }\n\n                            sess.emit_turn_item_completed(&amp;turn_context, turn_item)\n                                .await;\n                        }\n\n                        add_completed(ProcessedResponseItem {\n                            item,\n                            response: None,\n                        });\n                    }\n                    Err(FunctionCallError::MissingLocalShellCallId) =&gt; {\n                        let msg = \"LocalShellCall without call_id or id\";\n                        turn_context\n                            .client\n                            .get_otel_event_manager()\n                            .log_tool_failed(\"local_shell\", msg);\n                        error!(msg);\n\n                        let response = ResponseInputItem::FunctionCallOutput {\n                            call_id: String::new(),\n                            output: FunctionCallOutputPayload {\n                                content: msg.to_string(),\n                                ..Default::default()\n                            },\n                        };\n                        add_completed(ProcessedResponseItem {\n                            item,\n                            response: Some(response),\n                        });\n                    }\n                    Err(FunctionCallError::RespondToModel(message))\n                    | Err(FunctionCallError::Denied(message)) =&gt; {\n                        let response = ResponseInputItem::FunctionCallOutput {\n                            call_id: String::new(),\n                            output: FunctionCallOutputPayload {\n                                content: message,\n                                ..Default::default()\n                            },\n                        };\n                        add_completed(ProcessedResponseItem {\n                            item,\n                            response: Some(response),\n                        });\n                    }\n                    Err(FunctionCallError::Fatal(message)) =&gt; {\n                        return Err(CodexErr::Fatal(message));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::OutputItemAdded(item) =&gt; {\n                if let Some(turn_item) = handle_non_tool_response_item(&amp;item).await {\n                    let tracked_item = turn_item.clone();\n                    sess.emit_turn_item_started(&amp;turn_context, &amp;turn_item).await;\n\n                    active_item = Some(tracked_item);\n                }\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::RateLimits(snapshot) =&gt; {\n                // Update internal state with latest rate limits, but defer sending until\n                // token usage is available to avoid duplicate TokenCount events.\n                sess.update_rate_limits(&amp;turn_context, snapshot).await;\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::Completed {\n                response_id: _,\n                token_usage,\n            } =&gt; {\n                sess.update_token_usage_info(&amp;turn_context, token_usage.as_ref())\n                    .await;\n                let processed_items = output.try_collect().await?;\n                let unified_diff = {\n                    let mut tracker = turn_diff_tracker.lock().await;\n                    tracker.get_unified_diff()\n                };\n                if let Ok(Some(unified_diff)) = unified_diff {\n                    let msg = EventMsg::TurnDiff(TurnDiffEvent { unified_diff });\n                    sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, msg).await;\n                }\n\n                let result = TurnRunResult {\n                    processed_items,\n                    total_token_usage: token_usage.clone(),\n                };\n\n                return Ok(result);\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::OutputTextDelta(delta) =&gt; {\n                // In review child threads, suppress assistant text deltas; the\n                // UI will show a selection popup from the final ReviewOutput.\n                if let Some(active) = active_item.as_ref() {\n                    let event = AgentMessageContentDeltaEvent {\n                        thread_id: sess.conversation_id.to_string(),\n                        turn_id: turn_context.sub_id.clone(),\n                        item_id: active.id(),\n                        delta: delta.clone(),\n                    };\n                    sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, EventMsg::AgentMessageContentDelta(event))\n                        .await;\n                } else {\n                    error_or_panic(\"ReasoningSummaryDelta without active item\".to_string());\n                }\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::ReasoningSummaryDelta(delta) =&gt; {\n                if let Some(active) = active_item.as_ref() {\n                    let event = ReasoningContentDeltaEvent {\n                        thread_id: sess.conversation_id.to_string(),\n                        turn_id: turn_context.sub_id.clone(),\n                        item_id: active.id(),\n                        delta: delta.clone(),\n                    };\n                    sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, EventMsg::ReasoningContentDelta(event))\n                        .await;\n                } else {\n                    error_or_panic(\"ReasoningSummaryDelta without active item\".to_string());\n                }\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::ReasoningSummaryPartAdded =&gt; {\n                let event =\n                    EventMsg::AgentReasoningSectionBreak(AgentReasoningSectionBreakEvent {});\n                sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, event).await;\n            }\n            ResponseEvent::ReasoningContentDelta(delta) =&gt; {\n                if let Some(active) = active_item.as_ref() {\n                    let event = ReasoningRawContentDeltaEvent {\n                        thread_id: sess.conversation_id.to_string(),\n                        turn_id: turn_context.sub_id.clone(),\n                        item_id: active.id(),\n                        delta: delta.clone(),\n                    };\n                    sess.send_event(&amp;turn_context, EventMsg::ReasoningRawContentDelta(event))\n                        .await;\n                } else {\n                    error_or_panic(\"ReasoningRawContentDelta without active item\".to_string());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nasync fn handle_non_tool_response_item(item: &amp;ResponseItem) -&gt; Option&lt;TurnItem&gt; {\n    debug!(?item, \"Output item\");\n\n    match item {\n        ResponseItem::Message { .. }\n        | ResponseItem::Reasoning { .. }\n        | ResponseItem::WebSearchCall { .. } =&gt; parse_turn_item(item),\n        ResponseItem::FunctionCallOutput { .. } | ResponseItem::CustomToolCallOutput { .. } =&gt; {\n            debug!(\"unexpected tool output from stream\");\n            None\n        }\n        _ =&gt; None,\n    }\n}\n\npub(super) fn get_last_assistant_message_from_turn(responses: &amp;[ResponseItem]) -&gt; Option&lt;String&gt; {\n    responses.iter().rev().find_map(|item| {\n        if let ResponseItem::Message { role, content, .. } = item {\n            if role == \"assistant\" {\n                content.iter().rev().find_map(|ci| {\n                    if let ContentItem::OutputText { text } = ci {\n                        Some(text.clone())\n                    } else {\n                        None\n                    }\n                })\n            } else {\n                None\n            }\n        } else {\n            None\n        }\n    })\n}\n\nfn mcp_init_error_display(\n    server_name: &amp;str,\n    entry: Option&lt;&amp;McpAuthStatusEntry&gt;,\n    err: &amp;anyhow::Error,\n) -&gt; String {\n    if let Some(McpServerTransportConfig::StreamableHttp {\n        url,\n        bearer_token_env_var,\n        http_headers,\n        ..\n    }) = &amp;entry.map(|entry| &amp;entry.config.transport)\n        &amp;&amp; url == \"https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/\"\n        &amp;&amp; bearer_token_env_var.is_none()\n        &amp;&amp; http_headers.as_ref().map(HashMap::is_empty).unwrap_or(true)\n    {\n        // GitHub only supports OAUth for first party MCP clients.\n        // That means that the user has to specify a personal access token either via bearer_token_env_var or http_headers.\n        // https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/issues/921#issuecomment-3221026448\n        format!(\n            \"GitHub MCP does not support OAuth. Log in by adding a personal access token (https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens) to your environment and config.toml:\\n[mcp_servers.{server_name}]\\nbearer_token_env_var = CODEX_GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN\"\n        )\n    } else if is_mcp_client_auth_required_error(err) {\n        format!(\n            \"The {server_name} MCP server is not logged in. Run &#96;codex mcp login {server_name}&#96;.\"\n        )\n    } else if is_mcp_client_startup_timeout_error(err) {\n        let startup_timeout_secs = match entry {\n            Some(entry) =&gt; match entry.config.startup_timeout_sec {\n                Some(timeout) =&gt; timeout,\n                None =&gt; DEFAULT_STARTUP_TIMEOUT,\n            },\n            None =&gt; DEFAULT_STARTUP_TIMEOUT,\n        }\n        .as_secs();\n        format!(\n            \"MCP client for &#96;{server_name}&#96; timed out after {startup_timeout_secs} seconds. Add or adjust &#96;startup_timeout_sec&#96; in your config.toml:\\n[mcp_servers.{server_name}]\\nstartup_timeout_sec = XX\"\n        )\n    } else {\n        format!(\"MCP client for &#96;{server_name}&#96; failed to start: {err:#}\")\n    }\n}\n\nfn is_mcp_client_auth_required_error(error: &amp;anyhow::Error) -&gt; bool {\n    // StreamableHttpError::AuthRequired from the MCP error_message.contains(\"request timed out\")\n        || error_message.contains(\"timed out handshaking with MCP server\")\n}\n\nuse crate::features::Features;\n#[cfg(test)]\npub(crate) use id for the initial &#96;ConfigureSession&#96; request and the\n/// unique session id.\npub struct CodexSpawnOk {\n    pub codex: Codex,\n    pub conversation_id: ConversationId,\n}\n\npub(crate) const INITIAL_SUBMIT_ID: &amp;str = \"\";\npub(crate) const SUBMISSION_CHANNEL_CAPACITY: usize = 64;\n\nimpl Codex {\n    /// Spawn a new [&#96;Codex&#96;] and initialize the session.\n    pub async fn spawn(\n        config: Config,\n        auth_manager: Arc&lt;AuthManager&gt;,\n        conversation_history: InitialHistory,\n        session_source: SessionSource,\n    ) -&gt; CodexResult&lt;CodexSpawnOk&gt; {\n        let (tx_sub, rx_sub) = async_channel::bounded(SUBMISSION_CHANNEL_CAPACITY);\n        let (tx_event, rx_event) = async_channel::unbounded();\n\n        let loaded_skills = if config.features.enabled(Feature::Skills) {\n            Some(load_skills(&amp;config))\n        } else {\n            None\n        };\n\n        if let Some(outcome) = &amp;loaded_skills {\n            for err in &amp;outcome.errors {\n                error!(\n                    \"failed to load skill {}: {}\",\n                    err.path.display(),\n                    err.message\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        let skills_outcome = loaded_skills.clone();\n\n        let user_instructions = get_user_instructions(\n            &amp;config,\n            skills_outcome\n                .as_ref()\n                .map(|outcome| outcome.skills.as_slice()),\n        )\n        .await;\n\n        let config = Arc::new(config);\n        let model = config.model.clone();\n        let session_configuration = SessionConfiguration {\n            provider: config.model_provider.clone(),\n            model: model.clone(),\n            model_reasoning_effort: config.model_reasoning_effort,\n            model_reasoning_summary: config.model_reasoning_summary,\n            developer_instructions: config.developer_instructions.clone(),\n            user_instructions,\n            base_instructions: config.base_instructions.clone(),\n            compact_prompt: config.compact_prompt.clone(),\n            approval_policy: config.approval_policy,\n            sandbox_policy: config.sandbox_policy.clone(),\n            cwd: config.cwd.clone(),\n            original_config_do_not_use: Arc::clone(&amp;config),\n            features: config.features.clone(),\n            session_source,\n        };\n\n        // Generate a unique ID for the lifetime of this Codex session.\n        let session_source_clone = session_configuration.session_source.clone();\n\n        let session = Session::new(\n            session_configuration,\n            config.clone(),\n            auth_manager.clone(),\n            tx_event.clone(),\n            conversation_history,\n            session_source_clone,\n            skills_outcome.clone(),\n        )\n        .await\n        .map_err(|e| {\n            error!(\"Failed to create session: {e:#}\");\n            CodexErr::InternalAgentDied\n        })?;\n        let conversation_id = session.conversation_id;\n\n        // This task will run until Op::Shutdown is received.\n        tokio::spawn(submission_loop(session, config, rx_sub));\n        let codex = Codex {\n            next_id: AtomicU64::new(0),\n            tx_sub,\n            rx_event,\n        };\n\n        Ok(CodexSpawnOk {\n            codex,\n            conversation_id,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Submit the &#96;op&#96; wrapped in a &#96;Submission&#96; with a unique ID.\n    pub async fn submit(&amp;self, op: Op) -&gt; CodexResult&lt;String&gt; {\n        let id = self\n            .next_id\n            .fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst)\n            .to_string();\n        let sub = Submission { id: id.clone(), op };\n        self.submit_with_id(sub).await?;\n        Ok(id)\n    }\n\n    /// Use sparingly: prefer &#96;submit()&#96; so Codex is responsible for generating\n    /// unique IDs for each submission.\n    pub async fn submit_with_id(&amp;self, sub: Submission) -&gt; CodexResult&lt;()&gt; {\n        self.tx_sub\n            .send(sub)\n            .await\n            .map_err(|_| CodexErr::InternalAgentDied)?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub async fn next_event(&amp;self) -&gt; CodexResult&lt;Event&gt; {\n        let event = self\n            .rx_event\n            .recv()\n            .await\n            .map_err(|_| CodexErr::InternalAgentDied)?;\n        Ok(event)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Context for an initialized model agent\n///\n/// A session has at most 1 running task at a time, and can be interrupted by user PathBuf {\n        path.as_ref()\n            .map(PathBuf::from)\n            .map_or_else(|| self.cwd.clone(), |p| self.cwd.join(p))\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) fn compact_prompt(&amp;self) -&gt; &amp;str {\n        self.compact_prompt\n            .as_deref()\n            .unwrap_or(compact::SUMMARIZATION_PROMPT)\n    }\n}\n\n#[allow(dead_code)]\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub(crate) struct SessionConfiguration {\n    /// Provider identifier (\"openai\", \"openrouter\", ...).\n    provider: ModelProviderInfo,\n\n    /// If not specified, server will use its default model.\n    model: String,\n\n    model_reasoning_effort: Option&lt;ReasoningEffortConfig&gt;,\n    model_reasoning_summary: ReasoningSummaryConfig,\n\n    /// Developer instructions that supplement the base instructions.\n    developer_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Model instructions that are appended to the base instructions.\n    user_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Base instructions override.\n    base_instructions: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// Compact prompt override.\n    compact_prompt: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n\n    /// When to escalate for approval for execution\n    approval_policy: AskForApproval,\n    /// How to sandbox commands executed in the system\n    sandbox_policy: SandboxPolicy,\n\n    /// Working directory that should be treated as the *root* of the\n    /// session. deterministically.\n    cwd: PathBuf,\n\n    /// Set of feature flags for this session\n    features: Features,\n\n    // TODO(pakrym): Remove config from here\n    original_config_do_not_use: &amp;SessionSettingsUpdate) -&gt; Self {\n        let mut next_configuration = self.clone();\n        if let Some(model) = updates.model.clone() {\n            next_configuration.model = model;\n           next_configuration.model_reasoning_summary = summary;\n        }\n        if let Some(approval_policy) = updates.approval_policy {\n            next_configuration.approval_policy = final_output_json_schema: Option&lt;Option&lt;Value&gt;&gt;,\n}\n\nimpl Session {\n    fn make_turn_context(\n        auth_manager: Option&lt;Arc&lt;AuthManager&gt;&gt;,\n        otel_event_manager: per_turn_config.model_family = model_family.clone();\n        per_turn_config.model_reasoning_effort = session_configuration.model_reasoning_effort;\n        per_turn_config.model_reasoning_summary = session_configuration.compact_prompt.clone(),\n            user_instructions: session_configuration.user_instructions.clone(),\n            approval_policy: session_configuration.approval_policy,\n            sandbox_policy: session_configuration.sandbox_policy.clone(),\n            shell_environment_policy: config.shell_environment_policy.clone(),\n            tools_config,\n            final_output_json_schema: None,\n            codex_linux_sandbox_exe: config.codex_linux_sandbox_exe.clone(),\n            tool_call_gate: Arc::new(ReadinessFlag::new()),\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]\n    async fn new(\n        session_configuration: SessionConfiguration,\n        config: Arc&lt;Config&gt;,\n        auth_manager: Arc&lt;AuthManager&gt;,\n anyhow::Result&lt;Arc&lt;Self&gt;&gt; {\n        debug!(\n            \"Configuring session: model={}; provider={:?}\",\n            session_configuration.model, session_configuration.provider\n        );\n        if !session_configuration.cwd.is_absolute() {\n            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(\n                \"cwd is not absolute: {:?}\",\n                session_configuration.cwd\n            ));\n        }\n\n        let (conversation_id, rollout_params) = match &amp;initial_history {\n            InitialHistory::New | InitialHistory::Forked(_) =&gt; {\n                let conversation_id = ConversationId::default();\n                (\n                    conversation_id,\n                    RolloutRecorderParams::new(\n                        conversation_id,\n ),\n        };\n\n        // Error messages to dispatch after SessionConfigured is sent.\n        let mut post_session_configured_events = Vec::&lt;Event&gt;::new();\n\n        // Kick off independent async setup tasks in parallel to reduce startup latency.\n        //\n        // - initialize RolloutRecorder with new or resumed session info\n        // - spin up MCP connection manager\n        // - perform default shell discovery\n        // - load history metadata\n        let rollout_fut = RolloutRecorder::new(&amp;config, rollout_params);\n        let mcp_fut = McpConnectionManager::new(\n            config.mcp_servers.clone(),\n            config.mcp_oauth_credentials_store_mode,\n        );\n        let default_shell_fut = shell::default_user_shell();\n        let history_meta_fut = crate::message_history::history_metadata(&amp;config);\n        let auth_statuses_fut = compute_auth_statuses(\n            config.mcp_servers.iter(),\n            config.mcp_oauth_credentials_store_mode,\n        );\n\n        // Join all independent futures.\n        let (\n            rollout_recorder,\n            mcp_res,\n            default_shell,\n            (history_log_id, history_entry_count),\n            auth_statuses,\n        ) = tokio::join!(\n            rollout_fut,\n            mcp_fut,\n            default_shell_fut,\n            history_meta_fut,\n            auth_statuses_fut\n        );\n\n        let rollout_recorder = rollout_recorder.map_err(|e| {\n            error!(\"failed to initialize rollout recorder: {e:#}\");\n record any startup failures.\n        let (mcp_connection_manager, failed_clients) = match mcp_res {\n            Ok((mgr, failures)) =&gt; (mgr, failures),\n            Err(e) =&gt; {\n                let message = format!(\"Failed to create MCP connection manager: {e:#}\");\n                error!(\"{message}\");\n                post_session_configured_events.push(Event {\n                    id: INITIAL_SUBMIT_ID.to_owned(),\n                    msg: EventMsg::Error(ErrorEvent { message }),\n                });\n                (McpConnectionManager::default(), Default::default())\n            }\n        };\n\n        // Surface individual client start-up failures to the user.\n        if !failed_clients.is_empty() {\n            for (server_name, err) in failed_clients {\n                let auth_entry = auth_statuses.get(&amp;server_name);\n                let display_message = mcp_init_error_display(&amp;server_name, auth_entry, &amp;err);\n                warn!(\"MCP client for &#96;{server_name}&#96; failed to start: {err:#}\");\n                post_session_configured_events.push(Event {\n                    id: INITIAL_SUBMIT_ID.to_owned(),\n                    msg: EventMsg::Error(ErrorEvent {\n                        message: display_message,\n                    }),\n                });\n            }\n        }\n\n        for (alias, feature) in session_configuration.features.legacy_feature_usages() {\n            let canonical = feature.key();\n            let summary = format!(\"&#96;{alias}&#96; is deprecated. Use &#96;[features].{canonical}&#96; instead.\");\n            let details = if alias == canonical {\n                None\n            } else {\n                Some(format!(\n                    \"Enable it with &#96;--enable {canonical}&#96; or &#96;[features].{canonical}&#96; in config.toml. See https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/docs/config.md#feature-flags for details.\"\n                ))\n            };\n            post_session_configured_events.push(Event {\n                id: INITIAL_SUBMIT_ID.to_owned(),\n                msg: EventMsg::DeprecationNotice(DeprecationNoticeEvent { summary, details }),\n            });\n        }\n\n        let otel_event_manager = OtelEventManager::new(\n            conversation_id,\n            config.model.as_str(),\n            config.model_family.slug.as_str(),\n            auth_manager.auth().and_then(|a| a.get_account_id()),\n            auth_manager.auth().and_then(|a| a.get_account_email()),\n            auth_manager.auth().map(|a| a.mode),\n            config.otel.log_user_prompt,\n            terminal::user_agent(),\n        );\n\n        otel_event_manager.conversation_starts(\n            config.model_provider.name.as_str(),\n            config.model_reasoning_effort,\n            config.model_reasoning_summary,\n            config.model_context_window,\n            config.model_max_output_tokens,\n            config.model_auto_compact_token_limit,\n            config.approval_policy,\n            config.sandbox_policy.clone(),\n            config.mcp_servers.keys().map(String::as_str).collect(),\n            config.active_profile.clone(),\n        );\n\n        let mut default_shell = shell::default_user_shell().await;\n        // Create the mutable state for the Session.\n        if config.features.enabled(Feature::ShellSnapshot) {\n            default_shell.shell_snapshot =\n                ShellSnapshot::try_new(&amp;config.codex_home, &amp;default_shell)\n                    .await\n                    .map(Arc::new);\n        }\n        let state = SessionState::new(session_configuration.clone());\n\n        // Initialize zapabob sub-agent runtime\n        let agent_runtime = Arc::new(AgentRuntime::new(\n            session_configuration.cwd.clone(),\n            1_000_000, // Total token budget for agents\n            config.clone(),\n            Some(Arc::clone(&amp;auth_manager)),\n            otel_event_manager.clone(),\n            session_configuration.provider.clone(),\n            conversation_id,\n            config.model_reasoning_effort.unwrap_or_default(),\n            config.model_reasoning_summary,\n            config.model_verbosity.unwrap_or_default(),\n        ));\n\n        // Initialize async subagent integration\n        let async_subagent_integration =\n UnifiedExecSessionManager::default(),\n            notifier: UserNotifier::new(config.notify.clone()),\n            rollout: Mutex::new(Some(rollout_recorder)),\n            user_shell: Arc::new(default_shell),\n            show_raw_agent_reasoning: config.show_raw_agent_reasoning,\n            auth_manager: Arc::clone(&amp;auth_manager),\n            otel_event_manager,\n            agent_runtime,\n            async_subagent_integration,\n            tool_approvals: Mutex::new(ApprovalStore::default()),\n            skills: skills.clone(),\n        };\n\n        let sess = Arc::new(Session {\n            conversation_id,\n            tx_event: tx_event.clone(),\n            state: Mutex::new(state),\n            active_turn: Mutex::new(None),\n            services,\n            next_internal_sub_id: AtomicU64::new(0),\n        });\n\n        // Dispatch the SessionConfiguredEvent first and then report any errors.\n        // If resuming, include converted initial messages in the payload so UIs can render them immediately.\n        let initial_messages = initial_history.get_event_msgs();\n        let skill_load_outcome = }\n\n        // record_initial_history can emit events. We record only after the SessionConfiguredEvent is emitted.\n        sess.record_initial_history(initial_history).await;\n\n        Ok(sess)\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) fn get_tx_event(&amp;self) -&gt; Sender&lt;Event&gt; {\n        self.tx_event.clone()\n    }\n\n    /// Ensure all rollout writes are durably flushed.\n    pub(crate) async fn flush_rollout(&amp;self) {\n        let recorder = {\n      .fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst);\n        format!(\"auto-compact-{id}\")\n    }\n\n    async fn record_initial_history(&amp;self, conversation_history: InitialHistory) {\n          shell.as_ref(),\n        )))\n    }\n\n    /// Persist the event to rollout and send it to clients.\n    pub(crate) async fn send_event(&amp;self, turn_context: &amp;TurnContext, msg: self.send_event_raw(event).await;\n\n        let show_raw_agent_reasoning = self.show_raw_agent_reasoning();\n        for legacy in legacy_source.as_legacy_events(show_raw_agent_reasoning) {\n            let legacy_event = Event {\n                id: turn_context.sub_id.clone(),\n                msg: legacy,\n            };\n            self.send_event_raw(legacy_event).await;\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) async fn send_event_raw(&amp;self, event: Event) {\n        // Persist the event into rollout (recorder filters as needed)\n        let rollout_items = vec![RolloutItem::EventMsg(event.msg.clone())];\n        self.persist_rollout_items(&amp;rollout_items).await;\n        if let Err(e) = self.tx_event.send(event).await {\n            error!(\"failed to send tool call event: {e}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn emit_turn_item_started(&amp;self, turn_context: &amp;TurnContext, item: &amp;TurnItem) {\n        self.send_event(\n            turn_context,\n            EventMsg::ItemStarted(ItemStartedEvent {\n                thread_id: self.conversation_id,\n                turn_id: turn_context.sub_id.clone(),\n                item: item.clone(),\n            }),\n        )\n        .await;\n    }\n\n    async fn emit_turn_item_completed(&amp;self, turn_context: &amp;TurnContext, item: TurnItem) {\n        self.send_event(\n item,\n            }),\n        )\n        .await;\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) async fn assess_sandbox_command(\n        &amp;self,\n        turn_context: &amp;TurnContext,\n        call_id: &amp;str,\n        command: &amp;[String],\n        failure_message: Option&lt;&amp;str&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; Option&lt;SandboxCommandAssessment&gt; {\n        let config = turn_context.client.config();\n        let provider = turn_context.client.provider().clone();\n        let auth_manager = Arc::clone(&amp;self.services.auth_manager);\n        let otel = self.services.otel_event_manager.clone();\n        crate::sandboxing::assessment::assess_command(\n            config,\n            provider,\n            auth_manager,\n            &amp;otel,\n            self.conversation_id,\n            turn_context.client.get_session_source(),\n            call_id,\n            command,\n            &amp;turn_context.sandbox_policy,\n            &amp;turn_context.cwd,\n            failure_message,\n        )\n        .await\n    }\n\n    /// Emit an exec approval request event and await the user's decision.\n    ///\n    /// The request is keyed by &#96;sub_id&#96;/&#96;call_id&#96; so matching responses are delivered\n    /// to the correct in-flight turn. If the task is aborted, this returns the\n    /// default &#96;ReviewDecision&#96; (&#96;Denied&#96;).\n    pub async fn request_command_approval(\n        &amp;self,\n        turn_context: &amp;TurnContext,\n        call_id: String,\n        command: Vec&lt;String&gt;,\n        cwd: PathBuf,\n        reason: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n        risk: Option&lt;SandboxCommandAssessment&gt;,\n        proposed_execpolicy_amendment: Option&lt;ExecPolicyAmendment&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; ReviewDecision {\n        let sub_id = turn_context.sub_id.clone();\n        // Add the tx_approve callback to the map before sending the request.\n        let (tx_approve, rx_approve) = oneshot::channel();\n        let event_id = sub_id.clone();\n        let prev_entry = {\n            let mut active = self.active_turn.lock().await;\n            match active.as_mut() {\n                Some(at) =&gt; {\n                    let mut ts = at.turn_state.lock().await;\n                    ts.insert_pending_approval(sub_id, tx_approve)\n                }\n                None =&gt; None,\n            }\n        };\n        if prev_entry.is_some() {\n            warn!(\"Overwriting existing pending approval for sub_id: {event_id}\");\n        }\n\n        let parsed_cmd = parse_command(&amp;command);\n        let message = format!(\"Command execution requires approval: {}\", command.join(\" \"));\n        let event = EventMsg::ExecApprovalRequest(ExecApprovalRequestEvent {\n            call_id,\n            command,\n            cwd,\n            reason,\n            risk,\n            proposed_execpolicy_amendment,\n            parsed_cmd,\n            server_name: \"local\".to_string(),\n            request_id: self.conversation_id,\n            message,\n        });\n        self.send_event(turn_context, event).await;\n        rx_approve.await.unwrap_or_default()\n    }\n\n    pub async fn request_patch_approval(\n        &amp;self,\n        turn_context: &amp;TurnContext,\n        call_id: String,\n        changes: HashMap&lt;PathBuf, FileChange&gt;,\n        reason: Option&lt;String&gt;,\n        grant_root: Option&lt;PathBuf&gt;,\n    ) -&gt; oneshot::Receiver&lt;ReviewDecision&gt; {\n        let sub_id = turn_context.sub_id.clone();\n        // Add the tx_approve callback to the map before sending the request.\n        let (tx_approve, rx_approve) = oneshot::channel();\n        let event_id = sub_id.clone();\n        let prev_entry = {\n            let mut active = self.active_turn.lock().await;\n            match active.as_mut() {\n                Some(at) =&gt; {\n                    let mut ts = at.turn_state.lock().await;\n                    ts.insert_pending_approval(sub_id, tx_approve)\n                }\n                None =&gt; None,\n            }\n        };\n        if prev_entry.is_some() {\n            warn!(\"Overwriting existing pending approval for sub_id: {event_id}\");\n        }\n\n        let event = self.send_event(turn_context, event).await;\n        rx_approve\n    }\n\n    pub async fn notify_approval(&amp;self, sub_id: &amp;str, decision: ReviewDecision) {\n        let entry = {\n            let mut active = self.active_turn.lock().await;\n            match active.as_mut() {\n                Some(at) =&gt; {\n                    let mut ts = at.turn_state.lock().await;\n                    ts.remove_pending_approval(sub_id)\n                }\n                None =&gt; None,\n            }\n        };\n        match entry {\n            Some(tx_approve) =&gt; {\n                tx_approve.send(decision).ok();\n            }\n            None =&gt; {\n                warn!(\"No pending approval found for sub_id: {sub_id}\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Records input items: always append to conversation history and\n    /// persist these response items to rollout.\n    pub(crate) async fn record_conversation_items(\n        &amp;self,\n        turn_context: self.send_raw_response_items(turn_context, items).await;\n    }\n\n    fn reconstruct_history_from_rollout(\n        &amp;self,\n        turn_context: &amp;TurnContext,\n        rollout_items: &amp;[RolloutItem],\n    ) -&gt; Vec&lt;ResponseItem&gt; {\n        let mut history = ContextManager::new();\n        for item in rollout_items {\n            match item {\n                RolloutItem::ResponseItem(response_item) =&gt; {\n                    history.record_items(std::iter::once(response_item));\n                }\n                RolloutItem::Compacted(compacted) =&gt;       );\n                    history.replace(rebuilt);\n                }\n                _ =&gt; {}\n            }\n        }\n        history.get_history()\n    }\n\n    /// Append ResponseItems to the in-memory conversation history only.\n    async fn record_into_history(&amp;self, items: &amp;[ResponseItem]) {\n        let mut state = self.state.lock().await;\n        state.record_items(items.iter());\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) async fn replace_history(&amp;self, items: Vec&lt;ResponseItem&gt;) {\n        let mut state = self.state.lock().await;\n = rec.record_items(items).await\n        {\n            error!(\"failed to record rollout items: {e:#}\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub(crate) async fn clone_history(&amp;self) -&gt; ContextManager {\n        let state = self.state.lock().await;\n        state.clone_history()\n    }\n\n    async fn update_token_usage_info(\n        &amp;self,\n        turn_context: &amp;TurnContext,\n self.send_token_count_event(turn_context).await;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Record a user input item to conversation history and also persist a\n    /// corresponding UserMessage EventMsg to .await;\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the input if there was no task running to inject into\n    pub async fn inject_input(&amp;self, input: Vec&lt;UserInput&gt;) -&gt; Result&lt;(), }\n\n    pub async fn interrupt_task(self: &amp;Arc&lt;Self&gt;) {\n        info!(\"interrupt received: abort current task, if any\");\n self.services.show_raw_agent_reasoning\n    }\n}\n\nasync fn submission_loop(sess: Arc&lt;Session&gt;, config: Arc&lt;Config&gt;, rx_sub: Receiver&lt;Submission&gt;) {\n    let mut previous_context:            }\n            Op::PatchApproval { id, decision } =&gt; {\n                handlers::patch_approval(&amp;sess, id, decision).await;\n            }\n            Op::AddToHistory { text } =&gt; {\n                handlers::add_to_history(&amp;sess, &amp;config, text).await;\n            }\n            Op::GetHistoryEntryRequest { offset, log_id } =&gt; {\n handlers::list_mcp_tools(&amp;sess, &amp;config, sub.id.clone()).await;\n            }\n            Op::ListCustomPrompts =&gt; {\n                handlers::list_custom_prompts(&amp;sess, sub.id.clone()).await;\n            }\n            Op::Undo =&gt; {\n                handlers::undo(&amp;sess, sub.id.clone()).await;\n            }\n            Op::Compact =&gt; {\n                handlers::compact(&amp;sess, sub.id.clone()).await;\n            }\n            Op::RunUserShellCommand { command } =&gt; {\n                handlers::run_user_shell_command(\n                    &amp;sess,\n                    sub.id.clone(),\n                    command,\n                    &amp;mut previous_context,\n                )\n                .await;\n            }\n            Op::Shutdown =&gt; {\n                if handlers::shutdown(&amp;sess, sub.id.clone()).await {\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            Op::Review { review_request } extensions.\n        }\n    }\n    debug!(\"Agent loop exited\");\n}\n\n/// Operation handlers\nmod handlers {\n    use crate::codex::Session;\n    use crate::codex::SessionSettingsUpdate;\n    use inject input into current task\n        if let Err(items) = sess.inject_input(items).await {\n            if let Some(env_item) =\n    *previous_context = Some(current_context);\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub async fn run_user_shell_command(\n        sess: &amp;Arc&lt;Session&gt;,\n        sub_id: String,\n        command: String,\n        previous_context: &amp;mut Option&lt;Arc&lt;TurnContext&gt;&gt;,\n    ) {\n        let turn_context = sess\n            .new_turn_with_sub_id(sub_id, SessionSettingsUpdate::default())\n *previous_context = Some(turn_context);\n    }\n\n    pub async fn exec_approval(sess: &amp;Arc&lt;Session&gt;, id: String, decision: ReviewDecision) {\n        match decision {\n            ReviewDecision::Abort =&gt; {\n                sess.interrupt_task().await;\n            }\n            other =&gt; sess.notify_approval(&amp;id, other).await,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub async fn sess.interrupt_task().await;\n            }\n            other =&gt; sess.notify_approval(&amp;id, other).await,\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub async fn add_to_history(sess: &amp;Arc&lt;Session&gt;, crate::message_history::append_entry(&amp;text, &amp;id, &amp;config).await {\n                warn!(\"failed to append to message history: {e}\");\n            }\n        });\n    }\n\n    pub async fn get_history_entry_request(\n        sess: &amp;Arc&lt;Session&gt;,\n        config: &amp;Arc&lt;Config&gt;,\n        sub_id: String,\n        offset: usize,\n        log_id: u64,\n    ) {\n        let config = Arc::clone(config);\n        let sess_clone = Arc::clone(sess);\n\n        tokio::spawn(async move {\n            // Run lookup in blocking thread because it does file IO + locking.\n            let entry_opt = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {\n                crate::message_history::lookup(log_id, offset, &amp;config)\n            })\n            .await\n            .unwrap_or(None);\n\n            let event = Event {\n                id: sub_id,\n                msg: EventMsg::GetHistoryEntryResponse(\n                    crate::protocol::GetHistoryEntryResponseEvent {\n                        offset,\n                        log_id,\n                        entry: entry_opt.map(|e| codex_protocol::message_history::HistoryEntry {\n                            conversation_id: e.session_id,\n                            ts: e.ts,\n                            text: e.text,\n                        }),\n                    },\n                ),\n            };\n\n            sess_clone.send_event_raw(event).await;\n        });\n    }\n\n    pub async fn list_mcp_tools(sess: &amp;Session, config: &amp;Arc&lt;Config&gt;, sub_id: String) {\n        // This is a cheap lookup from the connection manager's cache.\n        let tools = sess.services.mcp_connection_manager.list_all_tools();\n        let (auth_status_entries, resources, resource_templates) = tokio::join!(\n            compute_auth_statuses(\n                config.mcp_servers.iter(),\n                config.mcp_oauth_credentials_store_mode,\n            ),\n            sess.services.mcp_connection_manager.list_all_resources(),\n            sess.services\n                .mcp_connection_manager\n                .list_all_resource_templates()\n        );\n        let auth_statuses = auth_status_entries\n            .iter()\n            .map(|(name, entry)| (name.clone(), entry.auth_status))\n            .collect();\n        let event = Event {\n            id: sub_id,\n            msg: EventMsg::McpListToolsResponse(crate::protocol::McpListToolsResponseEvent {\n                tools,\n                resources,\n                resource_templates,\n                auth_statuses,\n            }),\n        };\n        sess.send_event_raw(event).await;\n    }\n\n    pub async fn list_custom_prompts(sess: &amp;Session, sub_id: String) {\n        let custom_prompts: Vec&lt;CustomPrompt&gt; =\n            if let Some(dir) = crate::custom_prompts::default_prompts_dir() {\n                crate::custom_prompts::discover_prompts_in(&amp;dir).await\n            } else {\n                Vec::new()\n            };\n\n        let event = Event {\n            id: sub_id,\n            msg: EventMsg::ListCustomPromptsResponse(ListCustomPromptsResponseEvent {\n                custom_prompts,\n            }),\n        };\n        sess.send_event_raw(event).await;\n    }\n\n    pub async fn undo(sess: &amp;Arc&lt;Session&gt;, sub_id: String) {\n        let turn_context = sess\n            .new_turn_with_sub_id(sub_id, SessionSettingsUpdate::default())\n            .await;\n        sess.spawn_task(turn_context, Vec::new(), UndoTask::new())\n            .await;\n    }\n\n    pub async fn compact(sess: &amp;Arc&lt;Session&gt;, sub_id: String) {\n        let turn_context = sess\n            .new_turn_with_sub_id(sub_id, SessionSettingsUpdate::default())\n            .await;\n        // Attempt to inject input into current task\n        if let Err(items) = sess\n            .inject_input(vec![UserInput::Text {\n                text: turn_context.compact_prompt().to_string(),\n            }])\n            .await\n        {\n            sess.spawn_task(Arc::clone(&amp;turn_context), items, CompactTask)\n                .await;\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub async fn shutdown(sess: &amp;Arc&lt;Session&gt;, sub_id: String) -&gt; bool {\n        sess.abort_all_tasks(TurnAbortReason::Interrupted).await;\n        info!(\"Shutting down Codex instance\");\n\n        // Gracefully flush and shutdown rollout recorder on session end so tests\n        // that inspect the rollout file do not race with the background writer.\n        let recorder_opt = {\n            let mut guard = sess.services.rollout.lock().await;\n            guard.take()\n        };\n        if let Some(rec) = recorder_opt\n            &amp;&amp; let Err(e) = rec.shutdown().await\n        {\n            warn!(\"failed to shutdown rollout recorder: {e}\");\n            let event = Event {\n                id: sub_id.clone(),\n                msg: EventMsg::Error(ErrorEvent {\n                    message: \"Failed to shutdown rollout recorder\".to_string(),\n                }),\n            };\n            sess.send_event_raw(event).await;\n        }\n\n        let event = Event {\n            id: sub_id,\n            msg: EventMsg::ShutdownComplete,\n        };\n        sess.send_event_raw(event).await;\n        true\n    }\n\n    pub async fn review(\n        sess: &amp;Arc&lt;Session&gt;,\n        config: &amp;Arc&lt;Config&gt;,\n        sub_id: String,\n        review_request: ReviewRequest,\n    ) {\n        let turn_context = sess\n
